userStories.title: Adjust hero height for stats visibility
userStories.description: As a visitor, I want to see the stats section without scrolling so that I immediately understand the company's scale and capabilities.
acceptanceCriteria: Hero section height reduced from 100svh to ensure stats bar is visible above the fold
Stats bar visible on mobile (375px+), tablet (768px+), and desktop (1024px+, 1080p+) viewports
Hero content (headline, subtitle, CTAs) remains properly centered and readable
Video background still covers the hero area appropriately
Visual verification: Navigate to / and confirm stats bar (50+ Klubber, 100% Digital, 24/7 Platform) is fully visible without scrolling

userStories.title: Update map pin SVG color
userStories.description: As a visitor, I want the map pins to use consistent brand colors so the design feels cohesive.
acceptanceCriteria: Map pin SVG fill color changed from #16a34a to #1a3a2f (forest-900)
Both office location maps display pins with the updated color
Visual verification: Navigate to /contact and confirm map pins show the darker forest green color matching the site header
